snippet.title: Mistfall Hunter Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - store.steampowered.com/app/3282300

Mistfall Hunter is a dark fantasy extraction game where you team up or go solo to take down enemies corrupted by the blood of the gods. A new gameplay trailer offered a closer look at its grimdark world and adrenaline-pumping melee, ranged and magic combat. It's coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox on July 29th.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
